ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of fraud in Minnesota, including the Somali Autism Center, and follow the money trail to uncover those responsible
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota?
Who is behind the Somali Autism Center fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money trail, we can identify key players and expose the extent of the scheme.
